# Clara AI

> Clara AI is an AI agency operated by SNB Future Drive Pvt Ltd, India. It builds, deploys and manages custom AI systems for businesses: AI chatbots for websites and WhatsApp, AI calling agents, operations and BI dashboards, and custom AI agents. Clara AI serves clients in India, the Gulf, the USA and Canada, and Europe.

## What Clara AI builds

- AI chatbots for web and WhatsApp that answer from a company's own documents, qualify leads and hand over to people
- AI calling agents that follow up with leads and customers by phone
- Operations intelligence and BI dashboards that bring data from many systems into one live view
- Custom AI agents for specific business workflows

## How Clara AI works

Clara AI starts by diagnosing the current workflow, then builds on the client's real data. A version 1 demo is ready within 7 days of receiving the client's material. The system runs beside the client's team, with clear human handover rules, and Clara AI keeps managing and improving it.

## Clients

Clients include Hiranandani, Rustomjee, K Raheja, Nilkamal, KISNA, Vijay Sales, Apex Hospitals, The Hindu, Tempsens, Ergode and Zelenkofske Axelrod.
